acceptance_criteria.AC-ENTRY-1: The organizer-loaded root UserOptimizedTransformer recomputes to implementation fingerprint de768f1ff9ddee54a9ad83a67f3e1f205044c0ad5c723fc3bb4881093c97f611 without modifying protected organizer sources.
acceptance_criteria.AC-TEST-1: The complete CPU and GPU pytest suite passes without removing, weakening, or skipping required coverage.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CORRECT-1: The organizer default, all 13 executable final rows, all 28 feasible source-derived cases, and all seven held-out cases pass with zero failed elements; the exact authorized 100000-token resource case remains a non-pass skip.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PERF-1: Two complete final-matrix runs record reproducible timing, raw samples, backend counts, wall time, and geometric-mean speedup for the requested fingerprint.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PROFILE-1: An integrated profile records repository-owned Triton execution for final row 11 and exposes kernel timing and call counts.
acceptance_criteria.AC-EVIDENCE-1: Every executed test, benchmark, and profile command has an immutable attempt record tied to environment, implementation fingerprint, output artifact, wall time, and available accuracy, performance, backend, memory, or profiler metrics.
acceptance_criteria.AC-REVIEW-1: Independent provenance, result-consistency, workflow, documentation, and graph checks pass before a local submission-ready recommendation is issued.
